question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

27, 38, ?, 68, 87, 110
solution:
**Logic :** Consecutive prime number series is added to each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8015e866bfade36773aa39eb9ba2a07f7c22cebe345f7f326a9c76f06373932.png] 

Hence, **"51"** is the correct answer.
